settings.heading: Universal Under-Desk Clearance & Mounting
settings.row_content:
Dimensions: 18.5" W x 11.8" D x 2.2" H
Usable Storage: 17.2" W x 10.5" D x 1.9" H
Mounting Footprint: Requires 19" x 12" of flat under-desk space. The ultra-slim 2.2" profile preserves over 95% of ergonomic knee and thigh clearance on sit-stand desks.
Fasteners: Includes 6x heavy-duty wood screws & pre-cut 3M VHB high-shear adhesive pads for optional zero-drill mounting.

settings.heading: Integrated Rear Cable Pass-Through & Peripheral Charging
settings.row_content: Dual rear rubberized cable grommets allow power cords, USB-C fast-chargers, and Thunderbolt hubs to route directly into the drawer interior. Dock and charge laptops, tablets, trackpads, and hard drives silently out of sight while maintaining a 100% wireless desktop aesthetic.

settings.heading: Heavy-Duty 25 lb Load Rating & Silent Ball-Bearing Slides
settings.row_content: Precision-stamped from 1.2mm cold-rolled aerospace steel with a scratch-resistant matte powder-coated finish. Dual-stage full-extension steel ball-bearing rails are cycle-tested for over 50,000 smooth, whisper-silent extensions with zero sag under full payload.

settings.heading: 30-Day Setup Guarantee & Lifetime Hardware Warranty
settings.row_content: Every FocusDrawer is engineered for a lifetime of heavy daily use. We back all hardware, glides, and mounting brackets with an unconditional Lifetime Replacement Warranty and our 30-Day 'Clean Desk' Risk-Free Trial. If your workspace isn't visibly transformed, return it for a full refund.
